button-group.why: Each button in the group matches Button. Core has no joined group of Buttons: its Button dock stacks or splits whole Buttons at the bottom of a screen.

calendar.why: Calendar is the month grid of Date and time's Pickers set: its Header, Weekdays and Weeks of days. Date and time - Collapsed and the Time row have no Neon item.

card.why: Core has no Card: a surface is composed from Layer tokens.

collapsible.why: Collapsible is the disclosure behavior alone; Accordion is the Core component that discloses content.

date-picker.why: It is composed from calendar, which has no Counterpart.

dialog.why: Core has one modal: dialog follows Alert at the web look (ADR 0009).

field.why: Field is the label, helper and error text around a control: Text field's Title and Detail.

input-group.why: Input group is a field with leading or trailing content: Text field's Field with its unit and status.

label.why: Label is the title above a control: Text field's Title.

toggle.why: Supporting item: toggle-group is built from it.

toggle-group.why: A group of pressable options that filter or pick: Core's Selection tag.
